Thanks Thabo — received the VAT cert. A few quick items to keep the activation moving:

1) Completed supplier onboarding form (bank details + tax residency cert) — can you fill the attached Excel and return? We need the account in ZAR (if you want to invoice in USD we will need FX approval from finance).
2) Clarify whether Oceanic will charge South African VAT on invoices or expects reverse-charge treatment. If you are VAT-registered in ZA and charging VAT, we need the VAT line on the invoice that matches the certificate.
3) If Oceanic is a non-resident for tax purposes but registered only to collect VAT, our AP team may request a local tax representative confirmation. Do you have a registered tax agent or letter from SARS?

If you can return the Supplier_Onboarding_Form_OceanicZA.xlsx filled and your preferred invoicing currency, I will loop in AP to queue the supplier setup and issue PO-83421.

Regards,

Vivek — quick procurement / finance checklist from my side:
- AP needs: completed onboarding form, proof of bank account (bank statement or voided bank letter), and tax document matching the supplier name exactly.
- For non-US suppliers billing in ZAR: we generally allow ZAR invoices but will convert for reporting. Please note that if reverse-charge applies, Redwood will self-account where appropriate; we need written confirmation from the supplier about whether they will charge VAT.
- If Oceanic provides services from ZA to our EU customers, confirm whether there's any place-of-supply complexity — but that's for tax to confirm later.

I will flag this to AP with a note to expedite once we have the completed onboarding form and bank proof.
